translation: Flavor sweet, greatly cold, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to dispel seasonal (epidemic) qi, headache, body heat, great heat of the three burners (三焦), heat of the skin, heat blocked in the intestines and stomach diaphragm (鬲), induce sweating, stop wasting-thirst (消渴), vexation with counter-flow, abdominal distension, sudden qi with gasping, and throat heat; it may also be used as a bathing
